ABOUT

Mann's bot

Mann's bot (Mqnic's auto with freetoe's UI). Available for free.

  • v1.26Audit fixes: typed capital letters in All mode now decode as Caesar instead of Captcha; a scout screenshot pasted in All no longer wipes the current answer; corrected captcha characters now auto-copy; dragging plain text no longer triggers the image drop handler or clears the answer; extra files are reported when a mode reads only one; map detection requires the navy background even at 468×360; the captcha shortcut checks width; recognizer errors are logged to the console; the copy-retry no longer fires on unrelated clicks; fetched images obey the 30 MB cap; Patch Notes now mirrors the About changelog. Housekeeping: shared CipherState object instead of window.__ globals, captcha weights parsed only on first use, duplicate label/shift/reset code merged.
  • v1.25Color Text / Multi-Grid OCR: Replaced fixed-template restrictions with instant, pure offline recognition (<10ms). Added full ground-truth templates for missing words including coin and ancient (total 64 words). Dynamic projection segmentation now seamlessly auto-detects and solves any grid dimension (2×3, 2×4, 5×2, etc.) with 100% precision. Added dedicated Settings and Patch Notes views.
  • v1.24Caesar / Color Text / auto: glyphs are now compared on an area-averaged grid instead of point-sampled pixels (fixes scale/aliasing misreads); narrow letters such as I are no longer dropped; touching letters are split; unsure letters/words get a dashed outline with tap-to-swap runner-ups and pause auto-copy; Color Text reads the colour from the strongest ink pixels only (anti-aliased edges no longer wash it out) and treats grey ink as black; All mode runs Color Text before Caesar, rejects weak Caesar readings and makes Caesar beat other readers by a margin before it is chosen.
  • v1.23Captcha: the Captcha tab now reads the game captcha (4 / 6 / 8 characters, case-sensitive) with a small neural net that runs entirely in the page. Uncertain characters are outlined and offer tap-to-swap alternatives; low-confidence readings are not auto-copied.
  • v1.22Map and auto: a non-map image (a 720×200 puzzle strip, any Morse/A1Z26/Sort/Braille/Chinese/Words screenshot) pasted, dropped or uploaded while on Map now swaps to All and is decoded, instead of being merged on top of the map; pasted text on Map swaps to All too. All mode now recognises scout screenshots by size and by the navy map background rather than by aspect ratio alone, so a puzzle image that happens to be about 4:3 is no longer pulled into Map. The map and all 5 slots stay in memory when you switch tabs and until the page is refreshed: the top Clear button is hidden on Map, and Clear layer or the new Clear slot (asks to confirm) do the wiping. Fixes: multi-file uploads, multi-file drops and rapid pastes kept only the last image, because each new image cancelled the one still loading (images now load one at a time, in order); the movement copy buttons (ddddd, wwwww, sssss, aaaaa) copied nothing; upload could read an empty file list after the input was cleared; a stalled URL load can no longer block the queue (15 s timeout). Speed: merging a screenshot reuses one scratch canvas and blits it instead of reading and rewriting the whole layer, undo snapshots are capped at 15 per layer (was 40) and skipped for an empty layer, and the duplicate dragover listener is gone.
  • v1.21Speed: images decode straight from the file/clipboard blob (no base64 round-trip, off the main thread via createImageBitmap), recognition starts without waiting for a frame, the pre-decode preview repaint is gone so auto-copy fires sooner, copy uses the synchronous path whenever the page has user activation, the preview only repaints when the image or boxes change, and the 1.25 MB of example images load on demand instead of with the script. Fixes: clicking a mark/digit to correct it now updates the answer in All mode; the detection-box preview was never visible; the Copy-on-decode tick box never drew; switching tabs keeps your image and re-reads it (without touching the clipboard); a failed or stale image load can no longer wipe a newer result; touching glyph pairs (e.g. 19 -13 -98 with tight kerning) are split more reliably; background URLs are limited to http(s); keyboard access for Upload and the mode selector; clearer small text; reduced-motion support; changelog order.
  • v1.20Faster solve-to-copy path: auto-copy starts as soon as the answer is ready, clipboard requests no longer queue behind older requests, All mode skips the costly Chinese search after a high-confidence numeric-family match, image processing is capped at 1.2 MP / 1400 px, and sparse-image component scans allocate a smaller work queue.
  • v1.18Faster All mode: the Chinese-numeral recognizer (the only slow part of auto-detect) now prunes its template search, about 5–10× quicker with identical results.
  • v1.17Audit fixes: typed/pasted text now accepts the formats the help text promises (Morse with / or a word, A1Z26 with spaces or a word, Sort/Words with commas, Braille dot numbers or a word, unspaced binary, Chinese with trailing punctuation); a failed Apply or paste keeps your text and marks it invalid instead of wiping it; editing a cell into an invalid reading clears the answer instead of leaving a stale copyable one; changing Letter case keeps your cell corrections; detection boxes are drawn in every tab again; dropping on the drop zone loads once; Morse images up to 32 marks (8 letters) are read; removed the dead Sort-order dropdown and Confirm-guesses button; 30 MB image limit enforced.
  • v1.16Full vision logic from heist solva v7 integrated with mann ditto UI: all 8 puzzle types supported (All, Morse, A1Z26, Binary, Sort, Braille, Chinese, Words), interactive glyph cells, dual-mode ascending/descending sorting stamps, offline embedded templates and examples.
  • v1.15Sorter now has 2 windows: ascending and descending are shown side by side in two DECODED boxes, click either box to copy directly (toggle removed; ascending is copied on decode). Added numbers to words module cause why not ("WORDS" tab reads numbers and spells them out: 1 2 3 4 9 → one two three four nine). Copy on decode now works by default on Linux / Firefox: browsers that block clipboard after a slow decode now wait and copy on your next click or key press instead of failing. The whole DECODED box is now a button with visual flash feedback.
  • v1.14Fixed copy on decode and copy buttons to match bombs.html (reliable clipboard write with # prefix for in-game chat, direct textarea fallback, and click-to-copy on decoded answer box); added auto-detection for slashed number images.
  • v1.13Embedded offline digit templates; corrected touching-digit splitting and loop counting; canceled stale uploads; cleared failed results; confirmation for uncertain guesses; complete text correction; direct copy button; improved image dragging, paste, keyboard controls and single-cell Braille.
  • v1.12A1Z26: stylized chunky digits (e.g. 5 and 9 in 3/15/9/11/1) were coming out as ? and blanking the letter. Added loop-position checks (9 vs 6 vs 0), extra templates for flared fonts, and low-confidence digits are now shown as a dashed best guess instead of being dropped.
  • v1.11Braille: rows are now located from faint empty-dot outlines, fixing HFB being misread as UMK.
  • v1.10Drag & drop now works anywhere on the page, including images dragged from other web pages. A1Z26: wide digits (6, 9) were wrongly split in two when the row had many narrow 1s — now split by shape. Also looser digit match with hole-count check.
  • v1.9Removed BINARY tab (restored in v1.16). Reordered tabs to Morse, A1Z26, Braille, Sorter.
  • v1.8Added A1Z26 tab — numbers 1-26 split by / decode straight to letters.
  • v1.7Fixed abnormality with letters b and k for braille.
  • v1.6Fixed vanguard not clearing automatically when swapping modes. Optimization.
  • v1.5Sorter fix: numbers that were too close to eachother eg 22 77 91 were marked incorrectly.
  • v1.4Critical braille error with bottom-row dot detection. Should work as intended.
  • v1.3Sorter fix, braille fix. Added backgrounds, use imgur or just the custom color hex slider.
  • v1.2Minor bug fix, and added yellow coloring when image copy is ready.
  • v1.1Added vanguard.
  • v1.0Initial release.
CUSTOMIZE BACKGROUND
Pick a color, or paste an imgur link (a single-image imgur.com/… link or a direct i.imgur.com/… image link) to use as the page background — it's scaled to fill the screen automatically, no specific size needed. Your color and background settings are remembered on this device. A linked background needs internet access; image decoding does not.
SETTINGS & PREFERENCES

Settings Dashboard

Customize interface layouts, module behaviors, theme colors, and decoding options. Changes save automatically.
Global Presets:
🏛️ Caesar Cipher CLASSIC

Classic: Original shift input box with 1–6 buttons and standard dual stamps.
Enhanced: Smooth 0–25 range scrubber, tactile ±1 steppers, quick ROT13/presets, letter-by-letter transformation strip, and complete 25-shift instant lookup table.

🎨 Color Text ENHANCED

Classic: Standard horizontal color buttons with stamp grid.
Enhanced: Swatch selector with live word-count badges per color, active glowing indicators, unified copy toolbar, and quick 1-click color re-tagging on detected word cards.

🔢 Number Sorter ENHANCED

Classic: Dual side-by-side Ascending and Descending stamps.
Enhanced: Interactive sorting ribbon with toggleable direction, rank chips (#1, #2, #3...), and instant delta indicators.

📝 Numbers to Words ENHANCED

Classic: 6 stamp boxes in a 2×3 grid.
Enhanced: Filter ribbon (All, Normal, Even, Odd) to declutter the screen, and 1–6 keyboard shortcut triggers.

🤖 Captcha ENHANCED

Classic: Original character cells with runner-up buttons.
Enhanced: Confidence color bars (green/amber/red), inline Aa case flip button, and 1-click uppercase/lowercase copy chips.

📜 Standard Ciphers (Morse, A1Z26, Braille, Binary, Chinese) ENHANCED

Classic: Standard interactive symbol cells.
Enhanced: Step-by-step translation strip showing raw glyphs ➔ converted characters ➔ word, plus smart delimiter switcher.

🗺️ Scout Map ENHANCED

Classic: Original layer and slot controls.
Enhanced: Vent overlay opacity slider (see rooms through vents), slot thumbnail status dots, and quick action toolbar.
